method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: digg_get_feed
tools.title: Read the Digg feed
tools.description: Read published posts exactly as a Digg website Feed lists them: topic is all for the Home Feed across every public Topic (the default) or a public Topic slug (ai, science, sports and so on), with view Top, Newest, Best, Hot or Trending and, for Top, a range. The first limit posts are the first limit the website shows for the same selection, in the same order: Science, Trending, 5 is topic science, view trending, limit 5. With no view, all and every Topic read Trending, as on the website; a range without a view reads Top. An explicit selection never falls back to another sort. Trending selects up to 100 recent posts and preserves their order for the traversal; refresh after its one-hour cursor expires. Today resets at Pacific midnight. Continue with nextCursor and an unchanged selection; stop when it is null. Rankings move, and the website's first page can be up to ten minutes old; deduplicate by ID. unavailableCount counts posts in this slice that could not be returned.

topic.description: all for the Home Feed across every public Topic, or one public Topic slug such as ai, science or sports. Defaults to all.

view.description: Defaults to trending for all and every Topic, as on the website; a range without a view means top.

range.description: Top only. Defaults to today, in America/Los_Angeles.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page with the same topic, view and range.

unavailableCount.description: Stories in this slice of the website order that could not be returned, usually mid-update.

tools.name: digg_get_top_posts_of_the_day
tools.title: Read the top Digg posts of the day
tools.description: Read the top 5 posts of one Feed day, ranked by Digg Score, as Digg shows them: topic is all for every public Topic (the default) or a public Topic slug. A Feed day is a calendar date in America/Los_Angeles. The list shows today from 8:00 am Pacific once today has at least 5 posts; until then it shows yesterday, ranked by the Digg Score each post closed its day with. day and isToday say which day it is. Today's scores and order change; yesterday's are settled. Use returned UUIDs with digg_get_post.

topic.description: all for every public Topic, or one public Topic slug such as ai, science or sports. Defaults to all.

day.description: The Feed day the list belongs to, a calendar date in America/Los_Angeles.

isToday.description: True for today; false for the completed day before it.

diggScore.description: The Digg Score the list ranks by: the current score for today, or the score the post closed its day with. Null when no closing score was recorded; those posts come last.

unavailableCount.description: Posts in the list that could not be returned, usually mid-update.

tools.name: digg_search_posts
tools.title: Search Digg posts
tools.description: Search recent post titles and TLDRs in every public Topic using Digg semantic and keyword search, as the website does. Searches live posts from the last 90 days and returns only currently published posts, each with its Topic. Returns at most limit matches from the best 80 candidates across Topics; this is not a full historical archive search. Use returned UUIDs with digg_get_post.

tools.name: digg_get_post
tools.title: Read a Digg post and its sources
tools.description: Get a published post's copy, as its Digg post page shows it, and a page of attributed X or webpage sources by UUID, in any public Topic. Live and archived posts are readable; a post merged into another returns the surviving post, so the returned id and url may differ from the requested id. Continue sources with nextSourceOffset. Source text is an excerpt, not proof of every claim; cite the original URL. Missing and unavailable posts return the same error.

id.description: The stable story UUID returned by search or feed.

sourceLimitReached.description: True when the underlying 500-source reader bound was reached.

tools.name: digg_get_profile
tools.title: Read a Digg profile
tools.description: Read a person's or publisher's public Digg profile by Digg username, as its page at https://digg.com/u/<username> shows it: name, avatar, banner, bio, Connections (X, GitHub, website), the public Topics in which it is a Topic Influencer, the counts Digg can report so far, and which activity lists it has. The id is stable; a username can change, and an old username is not kept. A profile whose account is banned or has not finished signup returns status unavailable with no profile; an unknown username is an error.

username.description: A Digg username, as in https://digg.com/u/<username>. Case does not matter.

status.description: found with the profile, or unavailable when the profile exists but its account is banned or has not finished signup (profile is then null).

id.description: Stable profile id. A username can change; the id does not.

address.description: The X account's Digg page beneath this profile, when Digg has one.

topicInfluencerTopics.description: Public Topics in which this profile is a Topic Influencer.

counts.description: Counts Digg can report for this profile. An absent count is not yet available.

tabs.description: The activity lists this profile has, in page order.

tools.name: digg_get_profile_diggs
tools.title: Page a Digg profile's Diggs
tools.description: List the published posts a Digg profile has Dugg, newest Digg first, as the Diggs tab on https://digg.com/u/<username> shows them, with the total across every page. Page with nextCursor. Withdrawn Diggs and posts readers cannot see are left out. A profile whose account is banned or has not finished signup answers status unavailable. Only profiles whose tabs in digg_get_profile include diggs have this list; others, and unknown profiles, return an error.

username.description: A Digg username, as in https://digg.com/u/<username>. Case does not matter.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page of the same profile.

status.description: found with the list, or unavailable when the profile exists but its account is banned or has not finished signup (profile and total are then null).

total.description: How many published posts this profile has Dugg, across every page.

duggAt.description: When this profile Dugg the post.

tools.name: digg_get_profile_featured_in
tools.title: List where a Digg profile is Featured in
tools.description: Page the published posts that include, among their sources, an X post this profile wrote, as the Featured in tab of https://digg.com/u/<username> lists them: newest first, with the total. Quote posts and replies it wrote count; its reposts of someone else's post, webpage sources and website Connections never do. Only public Topics are included. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. A profile whose account is banned or has not finished signup returns status unavailable with no posts; an unknown username is an error.

username.description: A Digg username, as in https://digg.com/u/<username>. Case does not matter.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page of the same profile.

status.description: found with the list, or unavailable when the profile exists but its account is banned or has not finished signup (profile and total are then null).

total.description: How many published posts include an X post this profile wrote among their sources.

tools.name: digg_get_profile_followers
tools.title: Read a Digg profile's Followers
tools.description: Page through the people who follow a Digg profile, by Digg username, newest follow first, with the total. Each person links to their own Digg profile. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. A profile whose account is banned or has not finished signup returns status unavailable with an empty list; an unknown username is an error.

username.description: A Digg username, as in https://digg.com/u/<username>. Case does not matter.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of this same list. Omit for the first page.

status.description: found with the list, or unavailable when the profile exists but its account is banned or has not finished signup (the list is then empty and total null).

total.description: Everyone in this list, across all pages.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last.

tools.name: digg_get_profile_following
tools.title: Read whom a Digg profile follows
tools.description: Page through the Digg profiles a profile follows, by Digg username, newest follow first, with the total. Each entry links to that Digg profile. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. A profile whose account is banned or has not finished signup returns status unavailable with an empty list; an unknown username is an error.

username.description: A Digg username, as in https://digg.com/u/<username>. Case does not matter.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of this same list. Omit for the first page.

status.description: found with the list, or unavailable when the profile exists but its account is banned or has not finished signup (the list is then empty and total null).

total.description: Everyone in this list, across all pages.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last.
